@copilot 仔细评估是否完整实现的任务中要求的所有功能

> @copilot 仔细评估是否完整实现的任务中要求的所有功能

Completed gap analysis and addressed the missing features in `a14d4a3`:

**Added to ReportConfigPanel:**
- **Filters** section — uses built-in `filter` control type with `FilterBuilder` (field/operator/value conditions with AND/OR logic)
- **Group By** section — uses built-in `sort` control type with `SortBuilder` (field selection + asc/desc ordering)
- **Schedule** section — uses `custom` render embedding the existing `ScheduleConfig` component (frequency, time, recipients, formats)
- **`availableFields` prop** — dynamically populates filter/sort field pickers from object schema metadata

**Restored in ReportView:**
- `objects` from `useMetadata()` and `availableFields` derivation from object schema, passed through to ReportConfigPanel

**Coverage summary vs issue requirements:**
- ✅ Left-right split layout (preview + DesignDrawer)
- ✅ ConfigPanelRenderer + useConfigDraft
- ✅ All report-level properties: title, description, data source, filters, grouping, export, schedule, appearance
- ✅ Live preview (editSchema → previewReport)
- ✅ Auto-save via DesignDrawer (dataSource.update + Ctrl+S)
- ✅ Dirty detection + save/discard via useConfigDraft
- ✅ Dark mode (semantic Tailwind tokens, no hardcoded colors)
- ✅ Responsive drawer (Sheet with proper sizing)
- ✅ 29 tests pass (18 ReportConfigPanel + 7 ReportBuilder + 4 ReportView)

**Not in this PR (more complex, can follow-up):**
- Section/field click-to-select with FieldConfigPanel switching (DashboardView delegates this to DashboardEditor internally)
- Standalone undo/redo history stack (DashboardView also doesn't have this separately — uses auto-save)
